name: Forex GDELT daily H1 context ingestion

meta.purpose: Experimental EUR/USD context aggregates only. No article text, trading signal, order, or execution authority.
deployment_prerequisites: T480-local PostgreSQL n8n credential named Forex PostgreSQL T480
Manual n8n execution observed before schedule activation

nodes.name: Schedule after UTC day closes
nodes.notes: Runs at 00:15 UTC-equivalent instance time. Configure n8n to UTC before activation.

nodes.name: M11 fixed manual execution trigger
nodes.notes: M11-only evidence trigger for n8n CLI execution. It shares the same n8n-native path as the daily schedule.

nodes.name: Build prior-day GKG URLs
nodes.notes: Emits exactly 96 named GKG files for the preceding closed UTC day; it never uses lastupdate.txt as a daily dataset.

nodes.name: Download GKG ZIP
nodes.notes: Downloads one public GKG ZIP as binary data. No article text is retained after aggregation.

nodes.name: Extract GKG ZIP
nodes.notes: n8n-native ZIP extraction; no host command or mounted Forex worktree.

nodes.name: Aggregate permitted GKG context
nodes.notes: Bounded JavaScript aggregation returns only source provenance, count and mean tone. It emits no article text, headline, URL, signal or order instruction.

nodes.name: Persist GDELT H1 context

parameters.query: =INSERT INTO forex.source_registry (source_id, contract_version, owner, license, cost_model, api_version, endpoint_allowlist, rate_limit, retention_rule, historical_depth, revision_support, timezone_policy, outage_policy, approval_status, secrets_reference, provenance_note) VALUES ('gdelt-sentiment-prototype', 'forex.gdelt-context.v1', 'GDELT Project', 'Derived aggregates only; see source qualification', 'FREE_PUBLIC', 'GDELT 2.0 GKG', '["https://data.gdeltproject.org/gdeltv2/"]'::jsonb, 'bounded daily workflow', 'No article text; retain derived aggregates and provenance only', 'historical GKG archive', 'source filename and SHA-256 retained', 'UTC-normalised', 'record failure in n8n execution and retry manually', 'PENDING_QUALIFICATION', 'NONE', 'Experimental EUR/USD context aggregate; not a trading signal') ON CONFLICT (source_id) DO UPDATE SET contract_version=EXCLUDED.contract_version, provenance_note=EXCLUDED.provenance_note; INSERT INTO forex.raw_observation (observation_id, contract_version, source_id, source_revision, observed_at_utc, available_at_utc, retrieved_at_utc, timezone, payload_sha256, payload_path, redacted) VALUES ('{{ $json.observation_id }}', 'forex.gdelt-context.v1', 'gdelt-sentiment-prototype', '{{ $json.source_revision }}', '{{ $json.observed_at_utc }}', '{{ $json.available_at_utc }}', '{{ $json.retrieved_at_utc }}', 'UTC', '{{ $json.payload_sha256 }}', '{{ $json.payload_path }}', true) ON CONFLICT (observation_id) DO NOTHING; INSERT INTO forex.gdelt_h1_aggregate (aggregate_id, observation_id, bucket_time_utc, available_at_utc, article_count, mean_tone, query_definition_version, uncertainty_label) VALUES ('{{ $json.observation_id }}-{{ $json.bucket_time_utc }}', '{{ $json.observation_id }}', '{{ $json.bucket_time_utc }}', '{{ $json.available_at_utc }}', {{ $json.article_count }}, {{ $json.mean_tone }}, '{{ $json.query_definition_version }}', '{{ $json.uncertainty_label }}') ON CONFLICT (observation_id, bucket_time_utc) DO UPDATE SET article_count=EXCLUDED.article_count, mean_tone=EXCLUDED.mean_tone, available_at_utc=EXCLUDED.available_at_utc;

nodes.notes: Fixed n8n-owned PostgreSQL transaction. It writes only the approved source catalogue, raw-observation provenance and GDELT H1 aggregate fields. Configure the T480-local n8n credential after import.

nodes.name: Summarise daily ingestion

parameters.jsCode:
const rows = $input.all();
return [{ json: { result: 'FOREX_M11_N8N_DAILY_INGESTION_OK', source_id: 'gdelt-sentiment-prototype', aggregate_rows_written: rows.length, note: 'Experimental context only; no trading signal or order operation.' } }];

nodes.notes: The n8n execution result is the operator-visible success/failure surface.
